adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, attendees are persisted via `await prisma.booking.update({ ... attendees.createMany ... })` before calling `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` (not wrapped in try/catch and not in a DB transaction). If the calendar provider update throws, the mutation will error back to the UI even though the guests were already inserted. On retry, `uniqueGuests` is computed against `booking.attendees` from a fresh `findFirst` and will now be empty, triggering `TRPCError(BAD_REQUEST, "emails_must_be_unique_valid")`. This creates a real partial-success/failed-response scenario grounded in the diff.
